description: Use when the user asks what a specific competitor has recently done or changed. Returns recent tracked strategic moves for one competitor, newest-first — the existence of each shift plus a was→now summary and the real analysis date (never a fabricated date). Returns { covered: false } for companies IndustryLens doesn't publicly track, and an empty list for covered companies with no moves detected yet.
name: list_competitor_moves
title: List a competitor's recent moves
